| ✅  | Fix the icon and text alignment (new pushes add CSS; author says the screenshots are updated) |
| ✅  | Add before/after screenshots |
| ⚠️  | Fill out the self-review checklist (filled in, but several boxes are still unchecked) |
| ℹ️  | The alignment fixes are in three separate commits ("Align…", "Fix formatting via prettier", "Nudge… by 1px") instead of being squashed into the original commit |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to squash the follow-up commits into the first one.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update, @yashhh911! Please squash the three follow-up commits (alignment, prettier, 1px nudge) into the original commit, following the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html), so each commit is one coherent change. Please also check off the remaining self-review items that apply.
```
